chunks: "Whoever sends ahead children, counting them with Allah, they will shield him from the Fire by the permission of Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.قَدَّمَ: sent ahead; a reference here to children who die before their parent
key_terms.يَحْتَسِبُهُمْ: seeks their loss as a matter of reward with Allah

ai.seo_question: How does losing a child with patience and hope in Allah become a protection from the Fire?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one who loses children and bears that loss while seeking reward from Allah receives a great spiritual reward. Those children become a means of protection from the Fire by Allah's permission, expressing both divine mercy and the virtue of patient acceptance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.574 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever offers children (to Allah (swt), i.e., loses them and bears the loss patiently, seeking reward from Allah (swt)), they will shield him from the Fire, by the permission of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
